sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: Now is the perfect time to say something to someone that you've been meaning to say for quite some time, Taurus. Get it out in the open. Keeping it inside will only eat away at you. Stop worrying about the consequences and make the move. Today is the time to be bold and aggressive. Other people might respond in a similar fashion, so if you dish it out, be prepared to take it.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Check in with your emotional and monetary investments to ensure you're on the right path while the Gemini Full Moon aligns with Neptune, Pluto, and Uranus. A thorough account of your earnings and expenses will help you determine where you need to cut back or if it's time to ask for a raise. Making realistic adjustments will give you the freedom to dream bigger without losing common sense as Luna and Saturn align later today.

readings.text: The aspect at play reminds you that your future starts today. This is a good time to ask yourself: what do you want for your health? Do you want to ignore your body until invasive medical measures are required? Or do you want to have an informed, delightful experience of nurturing your body and your mind in a more preventive fashion? If you prefer the latter, maybe it's time to invest in an informative text: a healthy cookbook, a holistic hygiene reference, or a book on feng shui.

Your shared investments and property may require some action on your part. Just wait a few days before signing any paperwork or agreements. You and your partner should be on the same page, regardless.

ac.text: Don't shy away from direct conversations that can impact the future of your relationship or financial situation, darling Taurus. Check in with your emotional and monetary investments to ensure you're on the right path while the Gemini Full Moon aligns with Neptune, Pluto, and Uranus. A thorough account of your earnings and expenses will help you determine where you need to cut back or if it's time to ask for a raise. If your finances are entangled in a romantic or business partnership, make sure you are on the same page. Making realistic adjustments will give you the freedom to dream bigger without losing common sense as Luna and Saturn align later today.

astrosage.name: AstroSage
astrosage.text: Encourage your mind to be receptive to positive emotions like love hope faith sympathy optimism and loyalty. Once these emotions take complete command-the mind automatically responds positively to every situation. Today, you are likely to attain benefits from the help of your brother or sister.  Children cause some disappointment as they spend more time on outdoor activities than planning their career. Your eyes are so bright that they can light up a dark night of your lover. Interacting with eminent people will bring you good ideas and plans. Outstation travel will not be comfortable-but will help build important contacts. Your partner might do something fabulous unintentionally, which will be really unforgettable.
